# Fixture for PERF-PY-25 (safe): lambda then return — at most once per call
lang: python
file: app/interp.py
---
def linear_interpolation(points, x):
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        if points[i][0] <= x <= points[i + 1][0]:
            f_interp = lambda xi: linear_interpolation(points, xi)
            return {"value": x, "f": f_interp}
    raise ValueError("out of range")
